Hi guys, it’s JIENN💋 
Are you all doing well? This time, I’m back with a winter daily lookbook and v-log.
And I had a great opportunity to collaborate with nordgreen, a watch brand in Copenhagen, Denmark :)
It wasn't just to be sponsored, but it was a really good product.
As mentioned at the beginning of the video, every purchase leads to a donation of the buyer's choice, and the simple design allows you to choose both a watch frame and a strap, and to customize it to suit your mood and the mood of the day. Despite these advantages, the price is not very expensive!
I hope you find it helpful.
Thank you for your patience and enjoy watching this video! If you have any questions, please leave a comment. Thank you all the time🧡



*About Nordgreen
노드그린은 덴마크 코펜하겐에 위치한 손목시계 & 라이프 스타일 브랜드로, HAY와 B&O(뱅앤올룹슨)의 수석 디자이너였던 '야콥 바그너'가 디자인한 시계를 선보이는 브랜드입니다. 디자인 모토는 '클래식하고 미니멀한 디자인'과 '유행을 타지 않는 견고한 퀄리티'이고, 브랜드 모토는 '지속가능한 패션', '구매가 공급으로 이어지는 시스템’입니다.
따라서 시계 하나가 판매될 때마다 고객님께서 선택해주신 분야로 기부가 이어지는 'giving back'의 구조를 가지고 있습니다. 기부 분야는 환경(중남미), 식수(아프리카), 교육(인도) 총 세 가지 분야이며, 시계를 구매하시는 분들께서 한 가지 분야를 선택해주시면 노드그린의 파트너 NGO단체들이 해당 분야에 저희의 수익금 중 일부를 지원금으로 전달하는 시스템입니다.

Nordgreen is a watch & lifestyle brand based in Copenhagen, Denmark, featuring a watch designed by Jakob Wagner, chief designer for HAY and B & O (Bang & Olufsen). The design motto is 'Classic and Minimalist Design' and 'Robust Quality without Fashion,' and the Brand Motto is 'Sustainable Fashion' and 'Systems Leading to Supply'.
Therefore, each time one watch is sold, it has a structure of 'giving back' where the donation is made to the field selected by the customer. There are three areas of donation: Environment (Latin America), Drinking Water (Africa), and Education (India). If you choose a field, our partner NGOs will share some of our proceeds with you. This is a system for delivering funds.

Hi guys, it’s JIENN💋 
Are you all doing well? This time, I’m back with a winter daily lookbook and v-log.
And I had a great opportunity to collaborate with nordgreen, a watch brand in Copenhagen, Denmark :)
It wasn't just to be sponsored, but it was a really good product.
As mentioned at the beginning of the video, every purchase leads to a donation of the buyer's choice, and the simple design allows you to choose both a watch frame and a strap, and to customize it to suit your mood and the mood of the day. Despite these advantages, the price is not very expensive!
I hope you find it helpful.
Thank you for your patience and enjoy watching this video! If you have any questions, please leave a comment. Thank you all the time🧡



*About Nordgreen
노드그린은 덴마크 코펜하겐에 위치한 손목시계 & 라이프 스타일 브랜드로, HAY와 B&O(뱅앤올룹슨)의 수석 디자이너였던 '야콥 바그너'가 디자인한 시계를 선보이는 브랜드입니다. 디자인 모토는 '클래식하고 미니멀한 디자인'과 '유행을 타지 않는 견고한 퀄리티'이고, 브랜드 모토는 '지속가능한 패션', '구매가 공급으로 이어지는 시스템’입니다.
따라서 시계 하나가 판매될 때마다 고객님께서 선택해주신 분야로 기부가 이어지는 'giving back'의 구조를 가지고 있습니다. 기부 분야는 환경(중남미), 식수(아프리카), 교육(인도) 총 세 가지 분야이며, 시계를 구매하시는 분들께서 한 가지 분야를 선택해주시면 노드그린의 파트너 NGO단체들이 해당 분야에 저희의 수익금 중 일부를 지원금으로 전달하는 시스템입니다.

Nordgreen is a watch & lifestyle brand based in Copenhagen, Denmark, featuring a watch designed by Jakob Wagner, chief designer for HAY and B & O (Bang & Olufsen). The design motto is 'Classic and Minimalist Design' and 'Robust Quality without Fashion,' and the Brand Motto is 'Sustainable Fashion' and 'Systems Leading to Supply'.
Therefore, each time one watch is sold, it has a structure of 'giving back' where the donation is made to the field selected by the customer. There are three areas of donation: Environment (Latin America), Drinking Water (Africa), and Education (India). If you choose a field, our partner NGOs will share some of our proceeds with you. This is a system for delivering funds.
